result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues make restaurant names, delivery info, and category chips appear broken or cut off on this food delivery home screen.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off at the edge of the card in the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure horizontal scroll cards have enough width/padding so full names are visible.

issues.description: Delivery time text under Tokumaru Ramen Bar is garbled/overlapping as '25-3Ddelivery' instead of a clear time range like '25-35 min delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Fix text layout/spacing so delivery time and label do not overlap or corrupt (e.g. '25–35 min · Ramen').

issues.description: Category filter chips row is clipped on the right; a partial chip is visible and 'Healthy' may be cut, with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent end padding, fade, or peek of the next chip and ensure horizontal scroll works so all categories are fully readable.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20%) is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation, so most of the card and any title below it are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so the last cards can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Delivery fee lines use light gray text that is low-contrast and harder to read, especially next to bold titles.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of secondary meta text (delivery fees/times) to meet accessibility contrast guidelines.
